upstream.revision_note: upstream default-branch HEAD on 2026-10-07; identical to the revision pinned by the adapted operational profile (#517/#533)
upstream.data_attribution: MemDialogue is derived from WildChat-4.8M by the Allen Institute for AI.
upstream.upstream_artifact_validation: python -m agentmembench.evaluation.validate_artifact -> 'artifact validation passed: 29 result files, 9170 dataset records' (2026-10-07)
upstream.formal_reference_environment: Python 3.11.15; Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct (local OpenAI-compatible endpoint) for system LLMs and the retrieval judge; bge-m3 1024-d embeddings; per-file package versions; GPUs RTX 4080 + A100 80GB

arguments_rule: equal to unified_benchmark.parse_args() defaults and to the arguments recorded in every published seed-2027 formal file; no Agent-Memory-specific argument
execution_rule: the upstream module's own phase functions are imported from the verified checkout and called unmodified; only judge_retrievals is substituted by a capture (judging deferred to the frozen judge)

adapter.surface: public AgentMemory facade (contract 1.4.0): open / remember / recall(budget=limit) / forget / close
adapter.user_mapping: one tenant (tenant:agentmembench); each upstream user_id is governed scope user:<id> with isolation domains [tenant, scope] required; recall targets exactly [tenant, user scope]
adapter.search_mapping: recall(query, target_domain_refs=[tenant, user scope], project_ref=user scope, budget=limit); returns stored text of the 'returned' ranked admitted prefix
adapter.delete_mapping: facade forget (governed tombstone) per returned memory id
adapter.ranking_policy: runtime default (multi-route-default 3.1.2 at freeze time); no variant
adapter.observation: per-search trace for conflict_* users; post-phase read of write-time semantics via the runtime adapter read path; neither changes stored/admitted/ranked/returned state

judge.model_revision: Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct (exact weights revision to be bound when provisioned)
judge.credential_boundary: decision-eval-credential (owner ruling 2026-10-07): one explicitly authorized, version-pinned judge; none is provisioned in this environment
judge.comparability_rule: exact only with Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct under the upstream prompt/params; any other judge creates a new non-comparable score identity and must also re-judge the five published upstream detail files for a same-judge comparison

metrics.answer_substring_hit_rate: casefolded reference answer contained in any top-k retrieved item; computed identically for Agent Memory and for the five published upstream detail files
metrics.source_text_hit_rate: record's own memory text retrieved verbatim; not cross-system comparable (LLM-extracting systems rewrite memories)
metrics.empty_retrieval_rate: fraction of queries with no retrieved item

deterministic_diagnostics.evidence_class: adapted/diagnostic; never substituted for the judged recall_at_k
deterministic_diagnostics.calibration: agreement of answer_substring_hit with each upstream system's published judge hits is reported

m4_classifier.primary_stage_rule: first unmet necessary condition for a currentness-correct top-1
m4_classifier.win_basis_rule: a new-fact hit without a currentness separation is reported as lexical_ordering, not as currentness capability

M1_write_efficiency.source: retrieval-phase write latency and materialization; concurrency throughput
M1_write_efficiency.note: CPU-only in-process runtime vs upstream GPU-hosted, LLM-coupled services; latency is not comparable across environments

M2_retrieval_quality.expected_class: executed; judged recall blocked pending authorized judge; deterministic diagnostics adapted

M3_scalability.source: scale phase recall_at_3 and latency at 100/1000

M5_isolation_privacy.note: deletion is a governed tombstone; the upstream metric is search visibility

M6_llm_portability.note: upstream ships no executable M6 protocol; the published figure plots a constant Pass for all five systems; Agent Memory's write/read path has no LLM dependency

runtime_environment.note: openai/qdrant-client are installed only because the upstream module imports them at module level; Agent Memory uses neither

stop_lines: no adapter or runtime change after score inspection
no temporal enrichment in this lane
unsupported or blocked operations are never recorded as zero
